payload.description:
As a scanner engineer, I want new Plexus-eval behavior specified in Gherkin and executed by a runner, so that we prove observable outcomes instead of adding more Jest units for this path.

Feature: Executable Gherkin for Plexus-backed evaluation

  Scenario: Feature files are the eval specs
    Given Gherkin files for local Plexus evaluation
    When I run the feature test command
    Then each scenario is reported from those files
    And existing Jest unit and fixture-eval tests still run on their own command

  Scenario: Missing behavior fails the spec
    Given a feature scenario that is not implemented
    When I run the feature test command
    Then that scenario fails
    And no production code is required for the failure to be a missing step or a failing Then
payload.title: New Plexus-eval behaviors run from Gherkin feature files
